title.narrative: Malawi M1 Road Rehabilitation

description.narrative: The will finance identified priority sections for rehabilitation under Phase 1 (215km) of a three phase programme for the M1corridor. This DA implements Phase 1 and consists of four components:Component 1 SongweKaronga section of 46km (World Bank funded)Component 2 Chiweta-Kacheche section of 67km (EU/EIB funded)Component 3 KasunguKamuzu International Airport (KIA) of 102km (EU/EIB funded)Component 4: Project Implementation and Capacity Building (EU/EIB funded)

title.narrative: Logistics performance index infrastructure

description.narrative: World Bank Logistics Performance Index infrastructure measures the quality of trade and transport infrastructure (e.g. ports, railways, roads, ICT, etc.). The index is scored between 1 (very low) to 5 (very high) and is used as a basis for global country ranking. Alternatively, the index score can be used as a measurement unit. For more information please see: https://lpi.worldbank.org/international
